notes.title: v1.9.4: By Popular Request Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/b1b9f7c34957283d703a389a5e4f229bc0eb5358.jpg[/img]

The Pixile team is still hard at work on the Super Animal World expansion, which we’re now aiming to release in winter (...or whenever it’s ready), but we have a big bundle of surprises to share with you today as thanks for your patience!

By popular request, today we’re dropping one more Animal Pass, inspired by community requests from over the years. The By Popular Request Pass is our way of saying thank you to all of you in our amazing community of more than twelve million players. And, because we’re now back to self-publishing and thus free to make dumb business decisions, we’re making it a proper thank you by making it completely [b]FREE to claim[/b] until Super Animal World arrives.

We’ve also made a few quality of life improvements to the game, added new Super Animal breeds, and are kicking off an end of summer celebration in our first self-published patch since returning to full independence, so check out the video below or read on for all the details.

[h1]Highlights[/h1]

[previewyoutube=g78o74zR3Y0;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] The [b]By Popular Request Pass[/b] is packed with cosmetics inspired by the community, and is [b]FREE[/b] to claim throughout Season 11! Highlights of this pass include the Idol, Plague Doctor, and Trashcan Outfits, as well as the super-cute (and spiky) Mini Bearded Dragon pet and the Shy emote.
[*] The new [b]Super Animal World Supporter Pack DLC[/b] includes 3 unique Super Animal breeds, 12 cosmetics, and 750 tickets, and is available for those who want to support the expansion’s development and get a taste of Super Animal World themed items early.
[*] Catch some final sun rays before fall during the [b]Super End of Summer Royale[/b] event. It runs for three weeks and kicks off today with challenges, rewards, and fruity new Super Animal breeds each week!
[*] [b]Six additional new Super Animal breeds[/b] have been released from the Labs, with designs inspired or suggested by community members, just like the Animal Pass!
[*] We’ve also made [b]quality of life gameplay improvements[/b] and patched some bugs to improve player experience, including some significant changes to how the Zip-and-Go works.
[*] Don’t miss the first sneak peek of Super Animal World gameplay in the video above too! We’re really proud of how fishing, bug catching and hamsterball racing are shaping up and we can’t wait to share more about the expansion in the coming months.
[/list]
[h1]New FREE By Popular Request Pass[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/b0d7d5f4402551399115e329ae7797748a1312e4.jpg[/img]

The SAR community is one of the most creative and passionate fanbases out there, so this season’s Animal Pass is a tribute to all the incredible designs and suggestions you’ve shared with us! 

This Animal Pass is completely [b]FREE to redeem[/b] until the Super Animal World expansion arrives (aka during Season 11), as a thank you for all of your support and patience during the Super Animal World expansion’s ongoing development. Next season, it’ll move into the Animal Pass Archive, but if you claim it anytime between now and then, you’ll be able to re-activate it from the Archive later like any other pass!

The pass includes some of our favorite cosmetic requests and ideas from you, as well as a few of our own to round out the pass (including a gravestone tribute to the retired Super Juicer blender). Some of the items were requested by many different players over the course of months and years, but others were directly inspired by art submitted in our [url=https://discord.gg/animalroyale]Discord[/url]. A huge thanks to community members who provided beautiful reference designs for items and provided their permission to base our official items on them:
[list]
[*]Idol Set - Sunnyaan
[*]Wild West Set - KaDi
[*]Teddy Bear Set - fizzy.1
[*]Trashcan Set - Traffickoun
[*]Plague Doctor Set - com50c
[*]Night Vision Goggles - kyryashayatravka
[*]Hotdog and Superite Ties - N3on Assassin
[*]Cardboard Shotgun - Metawastaken
[*]Superite Sniper - posvxxxxxx 
[/list]
If you’d like to suggest cosmetics for the game, join our [url=discord.gg/animalroyale]Discord[/url] and drop your suggestions in the cosmetics channel, leave us game feedback in the feedback channel, or start a discussion here on Steam! We’re constantly inspired by your passion for the game and would love to hear what you want to see added next. :) 

[h1]Super Animal World Supporter Pack DLC[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/f81e38da5df18b83f776f60d5fafd3081856e985.jpg[/img]

The Super Animal World expansion is the most ambitious project we’ve attempted since we first set out to build Super Animal Royale itself in Early Access, and we only felt confident tackling it because of the love and support from all of you over the years.

The [b]Super Animal World Supporter Pack DLC[/b] is a way that you can directly support its development and bring a taste of Super Animal World into your game today with items inspired by the fishing, bug catching, and hamsterball racing minigames coming in the expansion. The pack also comes with three Super Animal breeds gorgeously designed by Erika, and the adorable Mini Dragon pet, who should NOT be allowed near anything flammable.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095340/Super_Animal_World_Supporter_Pack/

[b]The Super Animal World Supporter Pack DLC includes:[/b]

[h3]3 new Super Animal breeds[/h3]
[i](If you don’t have the base Super Animal for the breed, you’ll receive it upon purchase.)[/i]
[list]
[*]Super Dawn Songbird
[*]Super Dusk Raccoon
[*]Super Midnight Deer
[/list]
[h3]12 new cosmetics[/h3]
[list]
[*]Mini Dragon Pet
[*]Race Start! emote
[*]Fish Hook Piercing
[*]Hamster Ball Hat
[*]Racing Goggles
[*]Hamster Ball Racing Suit
[*]Checkered Flag melee
[*]Caterpillar Antennae
[*]Caterpillar Costume
[*]Butterfly Bow
[*]Butterfly Dress
[*]Bug Box Gravestone 
[/list]
[h3]SAW Tickets[/h3]
[list]
[*] 750 SAW Tickets (the perfect amount for an archived Animal Pass!)
[/list]
Our small indie team has grown to 15 people over the years, and it’s only because of all of you that we get to pour our hearts into this game and say it’s a career, so thank you from the bottom of our hearts to all of you who support us so much.

[h1]Super (End of) Summer Royale 2024[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/4dbb1ca3c466b6dec673a2494d4c99590e4dd5b1.jpg[/img]

The island’s season manipulation tech was a bit out-of-sync this year (we’ll get Thomas on that), but the wait is over: the [b]Super (End of) Summer Royale[/b] event is here! We’ve got three weeks of fun in the sun planned, with new Super Animals, challenges, and rewards each week, so you’d better put on some sunscreen. And don’t forget your ears!

Fruit baskets have been scattered around the island, which you can pick up to progress some of your weekly event challenges and restore a small bit of HP. You’ll also gain fruit by completing matches of any game mode. 

Check back on [b]Tuesday, October 1st[/b] and [b]Tuesday, October 8th[/b] for a new Super Animal breed and Summer Royale challenges, with new cosmetic rewards! 

Here’s this week’s challenge list:

[h3]5 challenge rewards to earn[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pineapple Glasses | [i]Collect fruit (1000)[/i]
[*]1500 XP | [i]Find and kick a beach ball in a match (5)[/i]
[*]Watermelon Helmet | [i]Deal damage with grenades and Lucky Cat Mines (250)[/i]
[*]750 Carl Coins | [i]Throw Zip-And-Goes (5)[/i]
[*]Seashell Necklace | [i]Open clams (5)[/i]
[/list]
[h3]New Super Animal breeds*[/h3]
[list]
[*]Super Tomato Frog (unlocked at lvl. 30)
[*]Super Dragonfruit Dragon (unlocked at lvl. 80)
[/list]
[i]*As a reminder, all event breeds are permanent additions to the Research Lab. Don’t burn yourself out trying to grind for them![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/eb3bbd309d7d080798c650cba045c5535868d7a2.jpg[/img]

[/list]

[/list]

[list]

[/list]
[u]Super Dragon breeds (unlocked at lvl. 80)[/u]
[list]

[h1]New in the SAW Shop: The Fish Bundle![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/86525a75f1f7f3b8085f9f355bae8b1ef9e0550e.jpg[/img]

Something’s fishy in the SAW Shop… and it’s not Ms. Macawsome’s tuna sandwich lunch this time.

The SAW Shop has new stock, including the [b]Fish Bundle![/b] It includes the following swimmingly swell swag:
[list]

[/list]
You can also pick up the following items, now in the rotation:
[list]

All of these items will be available for 48 hours in the SAW Shop starting tomorrow (September 25th) as Offers, with the exception of the Fish Bundle and Hot Coffee emote, which will be available all week as the Featured items!

They’ll be in the Shop’s rotation after that, so you’ll get additional chances to nab them later if you miss them this time.

[h1]New in Carl’s Cart[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/3299c9ead0e229787cce07e9af6779216a6a9c0a.jpg[/img]

Carl’s got some new stock too, including 5 legacy items from past Summer Royale events. These items will rotate in on the days that new Summer Royale challenges unlock, so be sure to check the Cart when Weeks 2 and 3 of the event begin!

Here’s what’s new and rattling around in the Cart’s backseat:

These legacy Summer Royale cosmetics have also been added to the Cart’s rotation (they’ll be guaranteed in the next few Cart inventory refreshes!):
[list]
[*] Blue Striped Umbrella
[*] Blue Beach Hat

[/list]
[h1]Pixile Plays[/h1]

[url=https://twitch.tv/pixilestudios][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/f6777d69e0772b1f89c0448f2f597b9168b13a77.jpg[/img][/url]

Join Catbaux, Kaity, Logan, and Michael for a special [url=https://twitch.tv/pixilestudios]Pixile Plays[/url] tomorrow, Wednesday September 25th from 11am to 1pm PDT as they talk about the new update, Super Animal World, and answer your burning questions!

We typically stream every other week on Fridays at 11am PDT, so even if you can’t make it for this stream, you can [url=https://twitch.tv/pixilestudios]follow the channel[/url] to get a notification when we go live in the future. With the By Popular Request Update out, we’re super excited to start sharing more about Super Animal World with everyone.

[h1]Quality of Life Changes & Bug Fixes[/h1]

[h3]Zip-and-Go Revamp[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/fd480b0cde25ad343a9c73a7b21c7441b3656df9.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]When deploying a zip-line, you’ll immediately begin riding it at maximum speed, opening up new ways to use it for mobility. Max speed is also a whole lot faster!
[*]You’ll also get a speed boost each time you hop between zip-line segments in a chain of existing Zip-and-Go lines. 
[*]Each boost adds to your overall momentum and five chained rides on average-length lines will bring you to maximum speed.
[*]The Ninja Booties powerup still provides a speed boost while riding a zip-line, but the maximum speed has the same cap.
[*]Holding a Zip-and-Go now provides a zoom-out effect of 15% to help with placing them vertically (and spot incoming enemies).
[*]New visuals and sound effects have also been added when chain riding between zip-lines!
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Super Juicer powerup has been removed (for now). Our philosophy for powerup design is for each powerup to have a clear niche that doesn’t overlap with others. It’s also important that powerups don’t have too many effects, and that those effects are reflected in their visual design. The Juicer just wasn’t carving out its own niche well enough, but you can still find a broken one in the Animal Pass as a gravestone! We’re planning to make further adjustments to the powerup system in the future too.  
[*]The Bandolier powerup now grants 10% faster reload speed in addition to its other effects. This includes the Hunting Rifle, which we feel should make for some exciting plays!
[*]Lucky Cat Mines can no longer be set off by teammates (and they still do not damage teammates). This change should open up more strategic uses for mines, as well as just avoiding teammates mistakenly tripping them.
[*]A new animation has been added for when Lucky Cat Mines are activated, making them more lively and visible before exploding, and fixing a visual issue when placed on conveyor belts.
[*]SMOMA’s gallery has been updated with the pieces from the “Land, Sky, and Sea” Fanart Contest! You can view all of the amazing submissions on the fanart contest site: [url=https://artcontest.animalroyale.com/]artcontest.animalroyale.com[/url]
[*]Bots will de-prioritize targeting downed players, especially if other enemies are nearby to attack instead. This change only applies to human players though, so they’ll still thirst other bot teams. Those tryhards.
[*]BCG egg projectiles are now affected by bullet speed modifiers (from private match commands or Mystery Mode).
[*]Swapping your equipped weapon no longer cancels actions like healing, taping, reviving teammates, emoting, etc.
[*]The snowy bridges in Thomas’ Tundra will now fade if a player is hiding behind them.
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed Modus splash logo. We’re fully indie and self-publishing again!
[*]Implemented better highlighting on text-fields and improved controller navigation to enter and exit typing. We published this change on PC in v1.9.3 but the change is now also reflected in the console versions.
[*]We’ve made some behind-the-scenes changes on the backend for how Animal Pass items are claimed to support larger inventories.  You shouldn’t notice anything from the change, but let us know if you have any issues when redeeming your items!
[*]The Flamberge melee weapon was made a bit thicker.
[*]Added /ziplines command for private matches to block access to ziplines.
[*]Sub-admins in private matches can now open the leaderboard and type after death, which also allows them to use the /score command for leaderboard printout. 
[*]Sub-admins can no longer kick each other from games.
[*]When sub-admins kick players in private matches, the main admin will now also be notified.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed bots pathing through SAW Security HQ’s secret room walls.
[*]Fixed hamster ball ping extrapolation not functioning. Other players were intended to be artificially extrapolated based on ping to counteract lag, which is now working.
[*]Re-eating bananas with the Banana Forker is now allowed if there was a desync or error between the client and server. This prevents bananas from being stuck or blocked, and keeps delicious banana peels from going to waste.
[*]Fixed ammo and other loot dropping far away when on Beaver Construction HQ bridges.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused loot to spawn over walls when dropped (particularly in shipping containers).
[*]Fixed a bug where the last zombie kill in the Bwoking Dead did not count towards XP gain.
[/list]  
Several character animation fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed Z-order glitch on Super Bat wings.
[*]Reduced visual recoil while shooting the Superite Laser.
[*]Improved torso/body textures turning with the Super Animal’s body.
[*]Made a small update to VFX in the Hole in One emote.
[*]Fixed Z-order of hands in the Banan Pew Pew emote.
[*]Nudged hand position in aiming animations for Dogna’s Dart Gun, SMG, and Bow & Sparrow.
[*]Fixed Z-order issue with hands in the juggling emote.
[*]Matched the Blue Beanie’s position to match other colored beanies.
[*]Improved arm bending in the SARturday Night Fever emote.
[*]Added custom deformation to sleeves while parachuting to improve bending.
[/list]
That’s all for the By Popular Request update! We hope you all have a ton of fun with the new content, and thank you so much again for all of your patience and support as the team works hard on the next big chapter of Super Animal Royale. We can’t wait to share more about the Super Animal World expansion with you as we continue development on it. See you on the island, Super Animals!

notes.title: Incoming 1.9.4 Patch + Double XP Weekend
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/dc1a3a866af7dd77a1f8a5b6ce5d2e314e4e338b.jpg[/img]

Our first self-published patch is [i]almost[/i] here, so we’re throwing a Double XP party weekend to celebrate!

We know many Super Animals are eager for more content (and we’re just as excited to get it into your paws), so we wanted to begin by letting you know that our first self-published patch (v1.9.4) is right around the corner. We’re finalizing a few items with the console makers behind the scenes, but the release is very close!

To set expectations, this patch primarily focuses on quality-of-life improvements and the Super (End of) Summer Royale event, as well as a couple of fun surprises we haven’t shared yet. The team is also still hard at work on Super Animal World and we’ll have some additional updates to share on its progress when v1.9.4 arrives. It’s a huge project so it’s taking us longer to build out and polish up than planned, but it’s shaping up really nicely so we can’t wait to share more of what it’s looking like with you soon.

We’ve already shared a few things to look forward to in v1.9.4 on our socials, and we’ve gathered the key details below in case you missed any of them:
[list]
[*] [url=https://x.com/AnimalRoyale/status/1813615966850621911]Zip-and-Goes are being reworked[/url]! Super Animals automatically grab onto the zip-line as it's being thrown, and riding multiple in succession grants a stacking speed boost.
[*] [url=https://x.com/AnimalRoyale/status/1820974334489293173]Teammates no longer set off Lucky Cat Mines[/url]. No longer will your teammate stumble through and explode your perfect trap.
[*] [url=https://x.com/AnimalRoyale/status/1831846938712379610]Bots de-prioritize downed targets[/url]. Bots will prioritize other actions such as resurrecting teammates and firing at standing targets rather than delivering the final blow to Super Animals.  
[*] The [url=https://x.com/AnimalRoyale/status/1829670194861785264]Super Dragonfruit Dragon[/url] will also be arriving to kick off the beginning of the Super End of Summer Royale event!
[/list]
[h1]Double XP Weekend[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/05d25330d31b60a322259deee3f66cad4e906382.png[/img]

From [b]Friday, September 20th[/b] to [b]Monday, September 23rd[/b] all XP from dailies, weeklies, and matches will be doubled! The Dragon’s Loot Pass will move into the Animal Pass Archive when v1.9.4 arrives, so if you have remaining tiers to earn or need a couple more levels, now’s a great chance.

Double XP also applies to account level and any pass from the Archive that you have activated on your second Animal Pass track. So even if you’ve already completed the Dragon’s Loot Animal Pass, you and your squadmates can make some gains on archived passes!

[h1]Shoulder Rider Pre-orders Close This Friday[/h1]

[url=https://youtooz.com/collections/super-animal-royale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/f6f527d94ce05b2d9d34a175409f60c49773c439.jpg[/img][/url]

Pre-orders for the [url=https://youtooz.com/collections/super-animal-royale]Youtooz Mini Fox & Red Panda Shoulder Riders[/url] close this [b]Friday, September 20th[/b]!

We also just announced [url=https://x.com/AnimalRoyale/status/1834315343155675552]last week[/url] that each one will come with their own respective in-game beanie, as seen in the image above, that’ll be sent out via e-mail when the plushies ship later this year. 

In case you missed their [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/FjVNEl20lwc]initial announcement video[/url], each Shoulder Rider plush has a magnet inside so you can stick them to their included fabric, magnetic disc (which you can slide under your shirt on your shoulder, hence the name) or magnet them directly to things like fridges, [url=https://x.com/AnimalRoyale/status/1832842970586021981]lamps[/url], [url=https://x.com/AnimalRoyale/status/1833287381279031459]gaming PCs[/url] – you name it. Special thanks to Cheryl, Erika and our friends at Youtooz for designing and bringing these plushies to life. 

That’s all for now, but we have so much more to share with you soon! Thank you for all the warm comments, support and your patience as we’ve made this big step to transition to self-publishing Super Animal Royale. This first patch took us longer than expected, but it’s a crucial milestone and lays the foundation for some really exciting updates to come that we’ll be able to publish ourselves! And the good news is, once we’ve gotten this first patch out the door, publishing future patches should be a whole lot smoother from here. A special thank you to Kaity, Clogg, and the incredible new teams handling porting, quality assurance, and release management for all the extra work they put into this patch’s release!

See you on the island, Super Animals.

notes.title: v1.9.2: Legends Come to Life in the Dragon’s Loot Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=U4302dKJegc;full][/previewyoutube]

A mythical new update has arrived, bringing with it the long-anticipated addition of Super Dragons! These fiery newcomers aren’t the only thing we’ve got to show off, so strap on ye olde knight’s armor and wizard’s garb, for ahead of us is a grand journey through everything new in the Dragon’s Loot Update.

[h1]Highlights[/h1]

[previewyoutube=mlhg2rMHOlY;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] The [b]Dragon’s Loot Pass[/b] is a treasure trove of fantasy-themed cosmetics to earn, including sets like the Wizard and Ranger outfits, the Penguin Palace Photo Booth scene, Coconut Canter emote, and of course, the adorable Mini Horse pet. Just… don’t try to ride it into battle.
[*] The [b]Season 10 Starter Pack DLC[/b] is now available, and features the delightful Super Fairy Skullcat.
[*] [b]Super Dragons[/b] have been released from their slumber to the Research Lab, with 6 distinct breeds to unlock!
[*] It’s the jolliest, most genetically-modified time of the year: [b]CRISPRmas![/b] For the next 3 weeks, new weekly challenges and Super Animal breeds will unlock as the event progresses. There’s a ton of legacy items to earn, too! 
[*] A wealth of [b]UI improvements, gameplay changes and bug fixes[/b] have been implemented to improve player experience.
[*] It’s [b]Super Animal Royale’s 5th Anniversary[/b]! To celebrate we have a coupon code for 4 free items, a new Super Animal, and a sneak peek of some of what’s coming in 2024.
[/list]
[h1]The Dragon’s Loot Pass[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/b7f7bb16b217fca28f874500f18d9e6a62c608d7.png[/img]

Gather your fellowship, Super Animals, because the Dragon’s Loot Pass is a golden hoard of classic fantasy-themed cosmetics to earn. It’s like an island-wide LARPing session… just with weapons that [i]aren’t[/i] made out of cardboard.
[list]
[*] During Season 10, the Dragon’s Loot Pass will be available for a discounted price of [b]550 S.A.W. Tickets.[/b]
[*] As always, you can continue working on passes you own from previous seasons on your second track for as long as you need, and you can purchase them from The Archive for 750 S.A.W. Tickets.
[/list]
[h2]Season 10 Starter Pack DLC[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/a04324334faed7d8de3c6101f50c3c20d7cd9660.png[/img]

A new season means a new Starter Pack DLC, available all throughout Season 10!

The [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640070/Super_Animal_Royale_Season_10_Starter_Pack/]Season 10 Starter Pack[/url][/b] features these magical items:
[list]
[*] Super Fairy Skullcat
[*] Fairy Armor
[*] Fairy Sword melee weapon
[*] 600 SAW Tickets
[/list]
The Starter Pack DLC for last season (Season 9) will be going into the vault on December 19th, so if you’ve had your eye on the Super Kitsune and its set, don’t forget to get it before then.

[h1]Thar be Super Dragons[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/4fcf1311f818fa86cf43b12626ff20b62db85a2e.png[/img]

The highly-requested [b]Super Dragons[/b] have awakened from their slumber to burninate the competition! As the island’s first mythical Super Animal species, they intend to prove why the tales of yesteryear held them in such fearsome regard.

Super Dragons are available in the Research Lab beginning at level 80, with six total breeds to unlock (two of which are Wyverns with a unique design):
[list]
[*] Super Dragon
[*] Super Orange Dragon
[*] Super Forest Dragon
[*] Super Superite Dragon
[*] Super Ice Wyvern
[*] Super Black Wyvern
[/list]
[previewyoutube=jQi_6kWmflQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We get a whole lot of requests for mythical species, and Super Dragons in particular, from all of you, and they’ve been in our plans for a long time so we’re so excited to finally release them from the labs! The whole team was so thrilled to see all the excitement for them when we released the first teaser trailer (above), and we hope you’ll all love their season.

[h1]Peace on Earth is Overrated: It’s CRISPRmas[/h1]

[previewyoutube=m2z2VTTI_90;full][/previewyoutube]

As winter arrives, Super Animal World is ready to celebrate everything CRISPRmas means to its Super inhabitants: friendship, generosity, peace (for now), and most importantly, the miracle of genetic modification! The event includes:
[list]
[*] 3 new Super Animal breeds
[*] 15 challenges to complete with 9 new event cosmetics
[*] 20 legacy cosmetics return from previous CRISPRmas events
[/list]
This year’s event functions differently from past years, with challenges to complete to earn the rewards. Here’s how it works:
[list]
[*] When each week begins, a set of five weekly challenges will unlock for you to complete, with three of these challenges awarding you with the event’s new cosmetic items. Once each week’s challenges have unlocked, you’ll have until the event ends to complete them and earn their rewards.
[*] Each week also debuts a new festive Super Animal breed in the Research Lab! As always, the animals are permanent additions so there’s no time limit to unlock them!
[*] Candy canes are scattered around the map to consume for a small healing effect and to count towards some of your challenges. 
[*] Snowmen (or are they snowanimals?) have been built around Thomas’ Tundra! You can smash them to get some candy canes, and some of the event’s challenges will require you to destroy them.
[/list]
[h2]CRISPRmas Week 1 [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/faafea483d95509d36353ded96648daa61a15c0e.png[/img]

We’ve got three weeks of gifts to unwrap this CRISPRmas, so check back for new Steam news posts each week with the debut of a new Super Animal breed and challenges!

Here’s what’s coming down the chimney in Week 1:

[h3]5 challenge rewards to earn[/h3]
[list]
[*] Candy Cane Tie | [i]Collect Candy Canes[/i]
[*] 1500 XP | [i]Smash Snowmen[/i]
[*] Present Outfit | [i]Get Kills[/i]
[*] 750 Carl Coins | [i]Chop Grass[/i]
[*] Present Tophat | [i]Land on Ice[/i]
[/list]
[h3]New Super Animal breed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Super Icicle Deer (available to unlock beginning at level 10 in the Research Lab and featuring transparency!)
[/list]
[h1]New SAW Shop and Carl’s Cart Items[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/0db352b82880cd4adb990c971ea2c574be41345f.png[/img]

Ms. Macawsome’s got some new items in stock, just in time for CRISPRmas! The [b]Street Art Bundle[/b] is available now, as well as the stylish [b]Checker Glasses![/b] 

The Street Art Bundle contains the following items:
[list]
[*] Street Artist Outfit
[*] Street Artist Bandana
[*] Spray Paint melee weapon
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/2cab48be50dd59778b605d7c0ddf9d432216c226.png[/img]

Carl’s Cart also has some new additions to its rotation: [b]Balloon Swords![/b] They come in three colors (red, blue, and green), and don’t ask Carl how he makes them deal as much damage as a typical melee weapon. They just do. 

[h1]UI Updates[/h1]
The game’s user interface has received some improvements and fixes that will help to save time and add clarity.
[list]
[*] Cosmetic & item icons now load from hard drive dynamically instead of on game launch. Considering how much SAR has grown over the years, this change will help improve load time and save hundreds of megabytes worth of memory usage. 
[*] When viewing cosmetic items, users may now briefly see hamster ball load spinners depending on hard drive speed.
[*] Adding an animal in the Photo booth now refreshes from Customize each time, in case there were changes made to the preset.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Show Pet" toggle in the Photo Booth wouldn't work if you had updated your preset with a pet later.
[*] Fixed the game modes screen being bugged on first launch for new players in certain regions.
[*] Fixed two bugs with death explosions in the shop: changing tabs while mousing over an explosion would position it in the wrong spot, and controller users changing shop tabs would leave the explosion running overtop of the character.
[*] Changed 'Grenade' to be 'Throwables' for hotkey settings.
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay and Map Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Several hamster balls and Giant Emus are now available to use in the pre-game lobby!
[*] Banana Forker healing has been reduced from 25 to 20 HP.
[*] Additionally, the Banana Forker no longer increases range and healing from event currency items like candy canes.
[*] Slightly increased banana drop rate from slicing grass.
[*] You can eat mushrooms, coconuts, and health fruit while downed. No hands required!
[*] Added priority back for the "Ride Emu" interaction, which should make dismounting to gather ammo easier, similar to before. Note that SvR flags, mole crates, Giant Mole boss crates, and downed teammates will not be overridden by a nearby emu (also similar to before).
[*] While riding a zipline, input for chain-riding versus exiting should be more accurate now, as previously it was very generous on detecting inputs to continue the ride.
[*] The Super Sea Land gift shop now has animated screens.
[*] You can now see other player characters picking up coconuts, mushrooms, and health fruit (previously, only your own character performed the animation).
[*] Cleaned up a few muzzle flashes so the last animation frame isn’t as easily mistaken as a bullet.
[*] Reduced collisions behind the Giant Mole boss.
[*] Added a private match command for /saw # and /rebel # to force a player to be on a specific SvR team.
[*] Improved player name tag position lag at low FPS.
[*] Fixed a spot at Lab to Table where emus would get stuck.
[*] Fixed a collision spot in Pete's Swamp between thorns and a stump.
[*] Fixed shadows on Le Waddle wall.
[*] Fixed Security HQ table having zip-lines go under it.
[*] Adjusted conveyors so bananas don't spin in circles on the corners. Sorry little dudes, no free rides.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a shadow sometimes appearing for broken hamster balls.
[*] Fixed a bug where breaking different types of destructible objects would only play the sound of one type.
[*] Fixed duplicated sounds when eating multiple things on an emu.
[*] The emoting while parachuting bug should be fixed.
[*] Fixed a bug where swapping to a weapon just after dropping it (while at higher ping) would leave the character stuck on the dropped weapon.
[*] Fixed vertical flicker issue with controllers and petting mini animals.
[*] Players spawning far in the skunk gas in the Bwoking Dead should be fixed now.
[*] Fixed event loot items fading out if on screen while becoming a Zombie Joe.
[*] Fixed bots not being able to go into secret rooms.
[*] Fixed some hit-reg issues when in high ping mode and shooting at walls.
[*] Several minor soft crashes should be fixed now.
[/list]
[h1]Celebrate SAR’s 5th Anniversary and Big Things Ahead in 2024[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/9da0d5ba13a55a614407ddfe0c55f8c3d919f1fa.png[/img]

To celebrate Super Animal Royale’s 5th anniversary with us, enter code [b]BIRTHDAY[/b] to get 4 items:
[list]
[*] Pixile Anniversary Firework melee weapon
[*] Pixile Umbrella
[*] Party Beads
[*] 5th Anniversary Cake Gravestone
[/list]
The new Super Piñata Donkey has also arrived in the Research Lab in time for the party, but the Lab Labs asked me to advise you against trying to find out if there’s candy inside: this piñata fights back.

It’s crazy to think of how far Super Animal Royale has come since its Early Access debut half a decade ago on December 12th, 2018, and we can’t wait to share all the big things we have in the works for its sixth year.

But before we look forward, we’d be remiss not to also look back and celebrate the exciting year we’ve shared with all of you. This year marked the first Respawning Day and the new event system for Howloween, the first marine Super Animals and Super Sea Land, the Photo Booth feature, the game’s first-ever collab with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097230/Turnip_Boy_Robs_a_Bank/]Turnip Boy Robs a Bank[/url], the [url=https://merch.animalroyale.com]Super Merch Shop[/url] and to top it all off, we officially crossed the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/843380/view/3641771972859480298]10 million total player mark this summer[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/31443552305a99bbbaccb482126e3c11e4b0662c.jpg[/img]

We’re so proud of what we’ve built and that so many of you enjoy playing it, and as big as 2023 has been, we can’t wait to make 2024 even bigger. We couldn’t do any of this without all of you in the community, so from all of us at Pixile, thank you so much for your support in building this world together that we all love to spend time in.

Before we sign off for this update we wanted to give you a bit of a peek at some of what we have planned next for the game, but we’re saving the biggest surprises for next year. Here’s some of what’s coming up next after CRISPRmas concludes in the new year:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/939378135053ec871bf6bba0fd58adf9387a5c60.png[/img]

We can’t wait to share more of what we’ve been working on for 2024 when it’s ready, and in the meantime, we hope you have a ton of fun with the Dragon’s Loot Update and CRISPRmas!

For week 2 and 3 CRISPRmas announcements be sure to follow SAR on [url=twitter.com/AnimalRoyale]Twitter[/url], [url=facebook.com/animalroyale]Facebook[/url], [url=instagram.com/superanimalroyale]Instagram[/url], [url=reddit.com/r/animalroyale]Reddit[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/animalroyale.com]Bluesky[/url] and [url=discord.gg/animalroyale]Discord[/url], or check back here on Steam each Tuesday at 10am PT.

[h2]Pixile Plays Stream Tonight at 5pm PT[/h2]

[url=https://twitch.tv/Pixilestudios][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586940/28343ba4f8e62790ea738be5be6462306e07da91.png[/img][/url]

If you’re reading this on launch day, tune in for a Pixile Plays live stream tonight at 5pm PT on Twitch to join the Pixile team in celebrating the game’s 5th anniversary, playing the Dragon’s Loot Update, and answering your burning questions: https://twitch.tv/Pixilestudios


[h2]Last Chance to Get Super Skullcat & Fox Plushies[/h2]

[previewyoutube=zp_MrjsDfco;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s also the last chance to get your order in for the [url=https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/super-animal-royale]Super Skullcat and Fox Plushies[/url] (with included in-game emotes)! Order by [b]December 17th[/b] to get yours,  and for anyone purchasing both, Makeship is offering 10% off.

We hope you’re all as excited as we are to get our hands on them when they ship in March! Codes for their emotes will be sent out within 1-2 weeks of the campaigns ending (depending on Makeship’s holiday hours since the campaigns end close to CRISPRmas).

We’ll see you all on the island, Super Animals, and happy holidays!
